sections.title: Where things are in the menus

blocks.text: Tab numbers are for P, Tv, Av, M and Fv modes. Auto and scene modes show shorter menus.

head: Tab
What's there
rows: Exposure comp / AEB, ISO, HDR, Highlight tone priority
Lens corrections, long exposure NR, high ISO NR
Multiple exposure, RAW burst, focus bracketing
Drive mode, interval timer, bulb timer, silent shutter, shutter mode
IS mode, Quick Control layout, image review

blocks.text: With the Mode dial on movie the tabs change: **Shooting 1** has High Frame Rate, **Shooting 5** has Time-lapse movie, **Shooting 6** has Zebra.

items: **Shooting 7 › Interval timer › Enable**, then set interval and shots.
Interval: 1 s to 99:59:59. Shots: 1–99, or **00** to run until you stop it.
The camera gets ready about 5 s before each shot; menus are locked in that window.
A shot is skipped if the camera is still busy, or if the shutter is longer than the interval.
In AF mode it won't fire unless focus is found. Focus, then switch to MF.
Stop it with **Disable**, or by turning the camera off.
Mode dial to movie, then **Shooting 5 › Time-lapse movie**.
Interval 2 s to 99:59:59 (1 s isn't possible). Shots 2–3600.
Output: 4K or Full HD MP4 at 29.97 fps (NTSC) or 25 fps (PAL). 3600 shots ≈ 2 minutes.
Auto exposure: **Fixed 1st frame** (steady) or **Each frame** (follows the light, may flicker).
No AF, no sound, no image stabilisation, and the flash won't fire during recording.
Don't zoom while recording. Turning the Mode dial cancels it.
A card not formatted as exFAT stops at 4 GB; the playback time shows red as a warning.
M mode goes to 30 s. For longer, turn the Mode dial to **B**.
**Shooting 7 › Bulb timer** sets the exposure length so you don't hold the button. It only works in B and clears when you change mode.
Bulb with ISO Auto uses ISO 400.
**Shooting 5 › Long exp. noise reduction:** Auto or Enable for 1 s and longer. Processing takes as long as the exposure.
Remote options: RS-60E3 cable, or BR-E1 wireless (press once to start, again to stop).

head: Mode
Speed
rows: 10 s, 2 s, or 10 s then 2–10 shots

blocks.text: Set it with the drive button or **Shooting 7 › Drive mode**. 15 fps needs 1/1000 s or faster and a well-charged battery.

items: Lens with an AF/MF switch: use the lens switch. Lens without one: use the AF/MF switch on the front of the camera.
Tap the magnify icon to zoom the view, move it with the cross keys, then turn the focus ring.
**AF 5 › MF peaking settings:** colours in-focus edges. Set level and colour.
**AF 5 › Focus guide** shows whether to turn nearer or further.
**Shooting 6 › Focus bracketing**: 2–999 shots, adjustable focus increment.
Can merge in camera (Depth composite) and crop the edges for you.
Needs AF (not MF) and a tripod. No flash. Fastest shutter 1/8000 s.

blocks.text: Mode dial **SCN › Panoramic Shot**. Choose a direction, hold the shutter and sweep steadily. Avoid moving or close subjects and large plain areas.

items: Set the camera up how you like, then **Set-up 5 › Custom shooting mode (C1, C2) › Register settings**.
**Auto update set.: Enable** saves changes you make while in that mode.
Ideas: C1 = astro, C2 = birds/action.
Built-in flash: raise it by hand. Guide number 6, so it reaches only a few metres. A lens hood can shade the bottom of the frame.
Flash doesn't work with the **Electronic** shutter mode, during movies, or with AEB.
Sync: 1/200 s mechanical, 1/250 s electronic 1st curtain.
EL/EX Speedlites (including the 420EX) fit the hot shoe directly. The 600EX-RT, 600EXII-RT, 580EX II and EL-1 need the AD-E1 adapter.
Flash exposure compensation: **Shooting 3 › Flash control**. Older EX flashes may not offer every menu setting.
